name: Ansible Security Review
description: Security review of Ansible playbooks, roles, and automation configurations. Covers credential management (Ansible Vault), privilege escalation patterns, insecure module usage, secrets in playbooks, role supply chain risks, and evaluation of Ansible-managed infrastructure compliance.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to Ansible security review

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands Ansible architecture, playbook structure, and common security concerns
evidence: Can explain Ansible inventory, playbooks, roles, and modules
Understands Ansible Vault and credential management concepts
Familiar with common Ansible security anti-patterns

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews Ansible playbooks under supervision using static analysis tools
evidence: Runs Ansible linting and security tools (e.g., ansible-lint, Checkov) under guidance
Identifies hardcoded credentials and insecure module usage using lab checklists
Documents Ansible security findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently reviews Ansible codebases for security issues and compliance gaps
evidence: Independently reviews playbooks for credential exposure and privilege escalation
Evaluates Ansible Vault usage and key management practices
Assesses role dependencies for supply chain risks
Produces compliant Ansible security review reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex Ansible review scenarios; develops custom rules; mentors others
evidence: Reviews complex multi-environment Ansible codebases with dynamic inventory
Develops custom ansible-lint rules for security policy enforcement
Reviews Ansible security work of junior analysts
Evaluates Ansible Automation Platform (automation controller, formerly Tower) or AWX deployment security and access controls

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab Ansible review methodology; publishes IaC security research
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's Ansible security review framework
Published research on Ansible security risks or automation exploitation techniques
Trains teams on advanced Ansible security review
Recognized as authority on configuration management security

assessment_methods.description: Review an Ansible codebase with intentional security issues and identify all misconfigurations and risks
Review Ansible security findings from recent IaC assessment engagements
